notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.notes:
Hello Inhabitants, we have some exciting news for you today,  a demo of Oddworld: Soulstorm Enhanced Edition is now available to download.

Oddworld: Soulstorm Enhanced Edition will be available on Tuesday, June 21st. Add the game to your wishlist, and help the community unlock these fantastic [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/619390/view/3217270937775668446]digital rewards[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/619390/Oddworld_Soulstorm_Enhanced_Edition/

If you enjoyed the demo please share it with your friends, and join the conversation with the community here on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/619390/discussions/]Steam[/url] and our friendly [url=https://discord.gg/oddworld]discord server[/url].

Stay Odd!

notes.title: Steam Wishlist Rewards: Unlock 1
notes.notes:
[b]Well, that was quick.[/b] You did it, the first milestone has been smashed and you’ve earned the first set of rewards for helping to spread the word about Soulstorm’s upcoming Steam release.

Today we’re revealing the next milestone, and a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/619390/view/3212766758951493109]quick recap[/url] of the campaign and how to take part.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288003/c40b090845ff1a559a6cc1fc9b185c35b9c491b5.jpg[/img]

To help towards that target, just sign in to or create a free Steam account and add Soulstorm to your wishlist. There’s a handy button for that, right on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/619390/Oddworld_Soulstorm_Enhanced_Edition/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=news&utm_campaign=wishlist0522]Soulstorm’s Steam Page[/url] and there’s also a useful widget that you can find right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/619390/Oddworld_Soulstorm_Enhanced_Edition/

To keep up with your fellow Oddworld fans, chat to some of the team who helped make the game and hear a [url=https://anchor.fm/oddworldinc]regular live Q&A[/url] with our Creative Director, Lorne Lanning, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/oddworld]friendly discord[/url].

And while you’re feeling the love, why not follow the official [url=https://linktr.ee/OddworldInhabitants]Oddworld social channels[/url] too?

We’ll keep you updated here as the campaign progresses.

We appreciate your support, Stay Odd!

notes.title: Wishlist Campaign Rewards
notes.notes:
Hello Inhabitants, 

This week we've been busy working on our Wishlist Campaign for the upcoming release of Oddworld: Soulstorm Enhanced Edition. We know that you are wondering what this is, so without further ado let's break down the details together. 

[h2]The details[/h2]
The wishlist campaign features tiered rewards, when we reach our targets we'll share this exciting digital content with the community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288003/55961b400998f815ef6eb0c8514ef1517c859b4d.jpg[/img]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[h2]I've already got Oddworld: Soulstorm, how can I get this content?[/h2]
The campaign will benefit both new and existing fans of Oddworld: Soulstorm. All you need to do is add the game to your wishlist on Steam. Once we reach the target, the content will be unlocked for the community! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/619390/Oddworld_Soulstorm_Enhanced_Edition/

[h2]How do I claim the rewards?[/h2]
The rewards will be available as a digital download on our website [url=https://www.oddworld.com]oddworld.com[/url] 

[h2]How will I know if the next tier is unlocked?[/h2]
You can follow the [url=https://linktr.ee/OddworldInhabitants]official Oddworld social channels[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/oddworld]friendly discord[/url]. We'll keep you updated here on Steam as the campaign progresses. 

We appreciate your support, Stay Odd!

notes.title: Full "Steam" ahead, Inhabitants!
notes.notes:
Oddworld: Soulstorm Enhanced Edition is coming soon to Steam! This will be the first opportunity to get the game on Steam, players will finally get to experience the latest instalment of Abe's even more explosive adventure! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/619390/Oddworld_Soulstorm_Enhanced_Edition/

The enhanced edition features all the latest improvements and tweaks to improve the gameplay as well as additional content including a new game mode in Toby's Escape. 

[previewyoutube=4LynVfmBO2k;full][/previewyoutube]

Oddworld: Soulstorm Enhanced Edition has recently been nominated for 'Best Art Direction' at [url=https://vote.webbyawards.com/PublicVoting#/2022/games/features/best-art-direction]The Webby Awards 2022[/url]. If you have a couple of minutes we would really appreciate your support, just head on over to the Webby Awards and register to [url=https://vote.webbyawards.com/PublicVoting#/2022/games/features/best-art-direction]vote[/url]. 

[previewyoutube=LWqJ790QRXY;full][/previewyoutube]
